Re-check of constraints and calculations:

Requirement: 800 units, one supplier only, delivery time <=25 days.

Eligibility:
- Alpha: max 800 >= 800 quantity PASS, 35 days > 25 FAIL -> excluded
- Bravo: max 1600 >= 800 PASS, 18 days <= 25 PASS -> eligible
- Cobalt: max 1600 >= 800 PASS, 10 days <= 25 PASS -> eligible

Formula: Total landed = (goods_value_USD + shipping_USD) * (1 + duty_rate)

Alpha - excluded, for reference:
goods = 10.97 EUR * 800 = 8,776 EUR *1.08 = 9,478.08 USD
+1,500 = 10,978.08 *1.08 = 11,856.3264 USD

Bravo - eligible:
goods = 1,826.66 JPY * 800 = 1,461,328 JPY *0.0067 = 9,790.8976 USD
+1,500 shipping = 11,290.8976
duty 4%: *1.04 = 11,742.533504 USD

Cobalt - eligible:
goods = 11.6 USD * 800 = 9,280 USD
+1,500 shipping = 10,780
duty 0%: *1.00 = 10,780 USD

Comparison: Cobalt 10,780 < Bravo 11,742.53. Lowest eligible is Cobalt.
